method: Read both full definitions and all sixteen complete occurrence cases at the requested corrected hashes; compared every actor, note, and prose claim with the complete cases; ran attribution and exact zc gates.

results.reason: Occurrence 8 structured the actor correctly as the unnamed verse author, but its reader-facing AttributionNote contradicted that structure by calling the exact actor the case narrator.
The definition named Muchen Conglang although no retained occurrence supports that claim, and described Yuanwu Keqin's attested statement as a question.

repairAfterReview.change: Made the AttributionNote name the unnamed verse author, agreeing with the complete case and structured actor.
Replaced unsupported Muchen Conglang with attested Yuanwu Keqin and changed asks to states.
